name: Reaper
text: A steel cutter bar for the edge of a field. Every 2 seconds it cuts every fully grown crop in the strip in front of it (5 wide, 5 deep, at its own height), replants each at the first growth stage, and pushes the harvest into the chest, barrel, hopper or storage port behind it; with no room it spills the harvest on the ground. Use it bare-handed to turn it. Redstone switches it off. Age V.
